verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into Darius's stacking Hemorrhage or get caught in Apprehend range; you win if you out-last the early lane and let the matchup's measured 52.6% edge show up from level 11 onward.

brief.thesis: Darius has no built-in gap-closer except E (Apprehend), a 535-range hook that pulls you to him and passively shreds your armor on hit — Ornn's only hard engage is E (Searing Charge), a 450-range charge that only knocks up if it hits terrain. That range and reliability gap is why OP.GG marks this lane and solo-kill advantage to Darius even though Ornn still wins the matchup 52.6% of the time over 1704 games once items come online.

theirWindow.what: He will poke with Q (Decimate) then hook you in with E to land free autos and W (Crippling Strike) slows, stacking Hemorrhage fast. Stay behind minions and don't give him a clean 535-range pull.

yourWindow.what: For 26/23.5/21/18.5/16 seconds he has no pull and no gap-close. Freely poke with Q (Volcanic Rupture, 800 range) or commit E (Searing Charge) into terrain for the knockup — he cannot punish you back into range.

start.why: Picked in 58.6% of games at 53.8% win rate — the regen and poke-reduction directly counters Darius's early auto-attack trades and Decimate blade hits.

boots.why: 82.8% pick rate at 54.1% win rate — flat reduction on the auto-attacks and Decimate hits that stack his Hemorrhage passive.

core.why: Gives armor and sustained AoE damage that punishes him for standing in melee range while you farm Hemorrhage stacks slower than he farms his own.
Direct counter to an AD melee bruiser who relies on extended auto trades and Decimate heals.
Part of the 55.9% win-rate core path over 68 games — stacks resistances the longer the fight runs, which is exactly how you want to play this lane out.

the enemy team adds burst magic damage alongside Darius
you need more sustain in drawn-out extended fights

runes.keystoneWhy: Sustains you through the extended melee trades Darius wants, and the proc heal directly offsets his Hemorrhage bleed stacks.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is run in 72.6% of games at 53.4% win rate — Teleport lets you reset after resolving his all-in windows and return scaled up, which matters since you're playing this lane for the late game, not the level 1-6 fight.

playing.title: Hug minions against E range
playing.detail: Apprehend is a 535-range hook — stay inside wave so he can't get a clean pull on you without also eating minion aggro.

playing.title: Poke with Q, don't auto-trade
playing.detail: Volcanic Rupture refreshes every 9/8.5/8/7.5/7 seconds at 800 range — use it to chip him down without feeding Hemorrhage stacks through melee autos.

playing.title: Punish his E cooldown
playing.detail: Apprehend is 26 seconds at rank 1, dropping to 16 at rank 5 — once he whiffs or uses it, you have a long window where he cannot engage you at all.

playing.title: Track stacks, not just health
playing.detail: Darius enrages and gains massive bonus AD once Hemorrhage hits 5 stacks on you — disengage before that threshold even if your health bar looks fine.

playing.title: Don't contest solo kills
playing.detail: OP.GG's own data gives Darius the solo-kill edge in this lane — play for farm and scaling, not for a 1v1 kill under tower.

playing.title: Respect tower dives on Ghost
playing.detail: Per OP.GG's tip, Darius can dive you under turret with Ghost when you're low — back off earlier than you would against a normal top laner.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers above are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own read of the matchup.

stats.opponentTip: Do not let Darius close in. Ignore his (E) with a well-timed [W], and keep him at bay with [Q] pokes. Be careful when you are low on health as he can simply dive under turret using Ghost.
